metadata.description: C4 Container diagram of SomeApp: a public-facing web application hosted on Infomaniak Public Cloud, served via Cloudflare CDN with S3-compatible object storage

elements.name: User
elements.description: End user accessing the web application via browser

elements.name: Cloudflare
elements.description: CDN and edge proxy. Terminates HTTPS at the edge (www.someapp.xx) and routes traffic to the origin server

elements.name: SomeApp
elements.description: Public-facing web application. Receives proxied requests from Cloudflare and serves the SomeApp product

elements.name: Object Storage
elements.description: S3-compatible object storage bucket hosted on Infomaniak. Stores application assets and data
